public_maturity: Five working demonstrations + controlled service framework

engagement_packages.name: Workflow Diagnostic
engagement_packages.purpose: Clarify the process, current-state pain, risk, automation suitability, recommended future state, and implementation estimate before a build commitment.

engagement_packages.name: Controlled Pilot
engagement_packages.purpose: Test one bounded recurring workflow with representative approved data, human-review gates, acceptance evidence, training, and a scale, revise, or stop recommendation.

engagement_packages.name: Full Implementation & Enablement
engagement_packages.purpose: Configure the approved future state in the authorized environment with permissions, documentation, governance, training, launch support, and administrator handoff.

engagement_packages.name: Optimization & Support
engagement_packages.purpose: Review performance, analyze errors, regression-test changes, refresh training, and maintain an enhancement backlog for a live workflow.

recommended_pilot_boundary.data: Representative, approved, and limited to the defined process
recommended_pilot_boundary.platform: Use systems the organization already owns whenever practical
recommended_pilot_boundary.decision: Scale, revise, or stop based on documented pilot evidence

qualification_privacy_boundary: The discovery worksheet runs locally in the browser and does not transmit form content by itself.
unvalidated_commercial_items: final public or private pricing structure

client credential and environment separation process for production work
not_claimed: measured organizational time or cost savings
production AI extraction or classification accuracy
live client-system integration from the public demonstration
